query:
SELECT 
                content_id,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN liked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::BIGINT, 0) AS "likes!: i64",
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN saved THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::BIGINT, 0) AS "saves!: i64"
            FROM content_engagement
            WHERE content_id = ANY($1)
            GROUP BY content_id
